description.zh: 说明：统计日期的结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, 最大查询范围1个月
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The time must be in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format. The maximum query range is one month.

description.zh: 查询条数；取值：最大不能超过5000，默认10
description.en: The number of entries to return. Maximum value: 5000. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询起始位置；取值：大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The starting offset for the query. Valid values: 0 or greater. Default value: 0.

description.zh: 说明：统计日期的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
description.en: The start of the time range to query. The time must be in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format.

description.zh: 批次状态；说明：0：未导入，1：导入完成 ，2：加载到缓存，3：呼叫完
description.en: The batch status. Valid values: `0` (Not imported), `1` (Imported), `2` (Loaded to cache), `3` (Calls completed), and 4 (Frozen).

title.zh: 获取呼叫任务批次列表
